description: Source code for nsScreencastService, a component handling screen capture sessions, encoding frames, and interfacing with WebRTC capture modules within Mozilla's codebase.

classes.name: nsScreencastService::Session
classes.description: Represents a screen capture session, handling frame encoding, callbacks, and communication with the client.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Session instance.

methods.name: ReuseCapturer
methods.description: Reuses existing capturer if associated with the same widget.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the capture session with specified capabilities.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the capture session and finalizes encoding.

methods.name: ScreencastFrameAck
methods.description: Acknowledges receipt of a frame, managing inflight frame count.

methods.name: OnFrame
methods.description: Callback for processing a captured video frame.

methods.name: OnRawFrame
methods.description: Callback for processing raw video frame data, encoding it as JPEG, and sending to client.
